name: G9 T3 W07 Part 2 - Review safety and compare risks
description: Review safety and compare risks. 2 words. Required: Flashcards and Fill in Blank. Read the Spark with the same name. Use this part in its Technology class.

words.definition: How likely something is to happen.
words.example: The probability of losing a file is higher when there is only one copy.

words.definition: How much harm a problem could cause.
words.example: Losing the only project copy has a high impact because the work is gone.
